phases.name: First Block (FB)
phases.description: Build a 1x2x3 block on the left side of the cube (typically matching the Left center, usually blue/white or green/white).

phases.name: Second Block (SB)
phases.description: Build a second 1x2x3 block on the right side of the cube using M and R layer moves without disturbing the First Block.

phases.name: CMLL (Corners of the Last Layer)

phases.name: LSE (Last Six Edges)
phases.description: Solve the remaining 6 edges (UL, UR, and the 4 M-slice edges) using only M and U moves in 3 substeps.

substeps.description: Orient all 6 remaining edges so white/yellow faces up or down.
Place the Upper-Left (UL) and Upper-Right (UR) edges into their correct positions.
Permute the remaining 4 M-slice edges to solve the cube.
